### 1. Scene
A breakfast tray: two eggs, grilled tomato halves, toast, a banana, Greek-style yogurt, a small butter packet, orange juice, and tea.

### 2. Vessels
- **Egg-and-tomato plate:** approximately 22 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 11² = **380 cm²**.
- **Toast plate:** approximately 20 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 10² = **314 cm²**.
- The other items are on the tray or in individual containers. Both plates appear to belong to this breakfast.

### 3–6. Items, coverage, volume, and weight
Areas are estimated from the food footprints, allowing for the photograph’s angle.

| Item | Area or coverage | Gross volume calculation | Density | Estimated grams |
|---|---|---|---|---:|
| Two cooked eggs | 33% of egg plate = 125 cm² | 125 × 0.85 cm = 106 ml | 0.95 | 101 |
| Grilled tomato halves | 24% = 91 cm² | 91 × 1.4 cm = 127 ml | 0.70 | 89 |
| Two overlapping toast slices | 65% of toast plate = 204 cm² | 204 × 1.5 cm average height = 306 ml | 0.30 | 92 |
| Banana, edible portion | Approximately 85 cm² pulp footprint | 85 × 1.3 cm = 111 ml | 1.0 | 110 |
| Greek-style yogurt | Approximately 28 cm² internal container area | 28 × 4.5 cm = 126 ml | 1.0 | 125 |
| Butter packet | Approximately 20 cm² | 20 × 0.5 cm = 10 ml | 0.95 | 10 |
| Orange juice | Approximately 38 cm² glass cross-section | 38 × 6.6 cm = 251 ml | 1.0 | 250 |
| Tea | Approximately 44 cm² cup cross-section | 44 × 5.2 cm = 229 ml | 1.0 | 230 |

**Coverage check:** eggs and tomatoes cover approximately **57%** of their plate; toast covers approximately **65%** of its plate. These match the visible uncovered rims and spaces. Banana peel and packaging are excluded.

### 7. Energy
Cooking fat is included in the cooked egg and tomato energy estimates rather than counted twice; no separate pool of oil is visible.

| Item | kcal per 100 g | Estimated kcal |
|---|---:|---:|
| Eggs, including cooking fat | 175 | 177 |
| Grilled tomatoes, lightly oiled | 40 | 36 |
| Toast | 265 | 244 |
| Banana | 89 | 98 |
| Greek-style yogurt | 120 | 150 |
| Butter | 717 | 72 |
| Orange juice | 45 | 113 |
| Plain tea | 1 | 2 |

### 8. Sanity check
Estimated total: **1,107 g and 990 kcal**, including **480 g of drinks**. Food alone is approximately **627 g**. This is plausible for the visible breakfast; yogurt fat content, butter-packet size, and cooking fat are the main uncertainties.
